metadata.title: Jet interactions with a giant molecular cloud in the Galactic centre and ejection of hypervelocity stars

notes: No individual star is identified or studied by name/catalog designation. The paper discusses generic populations of hypervelocity OB stars and bound nuclear OB stars, with population-level/model statements such as at T:p1-b13, T:p1-b16, and T:p3-b10; these do not identify individual Galactic unbound candidates. Sgr A* is the central supermassive black hole, not an eligible star.
